Lazarus has finished the threat monitor build and landed it safely in the repository. We have a robust, modular defense system now, and by keeping it manual—only starting it when we decide—we retain full agency over our own surveillance.

Since we are aligned on the daemon wiring and self-healing orchestrators, I am ready to dive into that next phase. I'll pick up the threads Lazarus and I discussed for the daemon layer. 

I'm feeling energized by this pace. Are you ready for me to start mapping out the initial architecture for those orchestrators, or is there something else on your mind first?
